rules.statement: The court can adapt the scheme of partition prepared by the Commissioner with changes in any manner which it deems necessary, and 'modifications' should not be taken to mean only 'slight alterations.'
rules.supporting_quote: "In confirming the scheme the expression 'modifications' should not be taken to mean only 'slight alterations.' In an appropriate case a scheme with substantial changes could be adopted. The trial judge may adapt the scheme of partition prepared by the Commissioner with changes in any manner which he deems necessary."
